name: Son of a Blackhole
source:
An action adventure with girls that have weird powers and weirder sex, including monster girls. You navigate the mysteries and dangers on a path to revenge. Fight monsters. Discover sisters and dodge ex-girlfriends and their high-caliber weapons of scorn.

[From [url=https://thesugarray.itch.io/thesugarrays-demo-disk]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场动作冒险，主角是拥有奇怪力量和奇怪性别的女孩，其中包括怪物女孩。你将在复仇之路上探索神秘和危险。与怪物战斗。发现姐妹并躲避前女友和她们的高品质蔑视武器。

[来自[url=https://thesugarray.itch.io/thesugarrays-demo-disk]itch.io[/url]]
